questions.question: Which organelle produces most of the cell's ATP?
questions.explanation: Mitochondria run cellular respiration, which makes most of the cell's ATP.

questions.question: Where are proteins made in the cell?
questions.explanation: Ribosomes read mRNA and join amino acids into proteins.

questions.question: Plant cells have a cell wall, but animal cells do not.
questions.explanation: Plant cells have a cellulose cell wall outside the membrane; animal cells only have the membrane.

questions.question: What molecule carries genetic information in almost all living things?
questions.explanation: DNA stores the instructions for building and running the organism.

questions.question: Which structure controls what enters and leaves the cell?
questions.explanation: The cell membrane is selectively permeable: it lets some substances through and blocks others.
